gaps.name: Android app build
gaps.why: Proved in a runner on 2026-10-27 (Actions run 40551081504): all three apps build a debug APK with no laptop - cleanbar 7.7 MB, nova-island 8.0 MB, fast-nova 78.6 MB. The toolchain is NOT the blocker any more; release signing is. Every app still signs with the debug key, which Play rejects, and no release keystore exists for any of them. Stays pc-only so a cloud run cannot pick it and ship a debug-signed APK; flip to [pc, cloud] once ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 and its three companions exist (docs/CLOUD_SECRETS.md).
blocking_dependencies: Flutter SDK (fast-nova only): cloned in the workflow; needs Gradle >= 8.14 and AGP >= 8.11.1
release signing keystore: 4 GitHub secrets; founder must create the keystore

gaps.name: Print-fidelity PDF build from Markdown
gaps.why: Two laptop-only assumptions, both fixable in code and neither needing money: the browser is a hardcoded Windows path, and the fonts live outside git. Point it at any Chromium on PATH and commit (or licence-check) the fonts, and this becomes cloud-ready like the EPUB build. See also MISTAKES 16-17: a font that is not installed is substituted silently, so the fallback must never be assumed to look right.

gaps.name: Roblox experience build
gaps.why: Studio is a Windows desktop application; only the Open Cloud publish step could move.
blocking_dependencies: Roblox Open Cloud key: would need a secret

gaps.name: Local image generation (FLUX.1-schnell on OpenVINO)
gaps.why: The cloud equivalent is a hosted image model, which costs money. Local stays free.
blocking_dependencies: FLUX.1-schnell int4: must be fetched; several GB
Intel CPU/iGPU: no iGPU in a standard runner

gaps.name: PC control and device automation
gaps.why: A device capability by nature: the cloud can queue a command, only the PC can perform it.

gaps.name: Chrome Web Store publishing
gaps.why: Code is ready for the cloud: cws_publish.mjs takes CWS_CLIENT_ID / CWS_CLIENT_SECRET / CWS_REFRESH_TOKEN / CWS_PUBLISHER_ID from the environment and falls back to the laptop vault. Still blocked because CWS_REFRESH_TOKEN has never been obtained - one founder Google consent. Proved on 2026-10-27 that it refuses with NOT CONNECTED before uploading anything when the token is absent.
blocking_dependencies: CWS client id/secret/refresh token: needs a one-time founder Google consent

gaps.name: YouTube upload and scheduling
gaps.why: Code is stdlib and env-driven, so it would run anywhere: YT_CLIENT_ID / YT_CLIENT_SECRET / YT_REFRESH_TOKEN as GitHub secrets is all it needs. It is policy, not capability, that keeps it on the laptop - the founder's rule that publishing happens there, and 13 channel credentials in one place being a bigger blast radius than one. See docs/CLOUD_SECRETS.md.
blocking_dependencies: YT_CLIENT_ID / YT_CLIENT_SECRET / YT_REFRESH_TOKEN: would need the same values as GitHub secrets; founder rule keeps publishing on the laptop

list.name: Comic or manga episode
list.summary: One episode of an original series: script, panel layout, art and the per-platform export. Characters and plots are the company's own.

list.name: Course outline and lesson pack
list.summary: A course in the company's shape: promise, module and lesson outline, scripts, exercises and the platform listing pack.

list.name: Workbook or ebook for KDP and direct sale
list.summary: A workbook or short non-fiction ebook in the company's shape: structure, interior layout, cover brief, front and back matter, and the KDP + direct listing pack. Original content only.

list.name: Chrome MV3 extension with a Pro tier
list.summary: A Manifest V3 extension with the company's standard shape: options page, storage, Material You theme, a Pro tier with checkout and licence activation, and a store listing pack. The billing stack and the theme are written and proven; only the feature and its UI change.

list.name: Kai and Orbi explainer Short
list.summary: A 28-35 s vertical explainer with Kai and Orbi: illustrated beats, pro captions, animated watermark, lip sync, camera push and synth sound design. The engine is written and proven; only the topic, the scene art and the colours change per episode.

list.name: Product landing site
list.summary: The one-page site every product gets: what it does, who it is for, pricing, privacy and the legal pages, in the company design system. Deployed on push.

list.name: Roblox experience
list.summary: A Roblox experience in the company's shape: place structure, Luau systems, a monetisation surface and the publish pack. The build and publish steps are known; only the game design changes.

list.name: Shop product listing
list.summary: A product listing in the company's shape: supplier check, pricing with real margins, images, copy and the store upload pack.

list.name: Long-form sleep / ambient loop
list.summary: A 6-10 hour sleep or ambient video with original synthesised music and a calm night scene. An 8 h video cannot be rendered frame by frame, so one exactly-periodic 128 s segment is rendered and repeated losslessly by ffmpeg. Production calls no model at all: every sample is additive synthesis and every pixel is pycairo. Only the palette and the chord progression change per video.

list.name: Social post pack
list.summary: A pack of posts for one idea across the platforms a team is connected to: image or clip, caption, hashtags and the posting plan. Nothing is published without a founder YES.
